From 73b5ab27ab2ee616f2709dc212c2b0007894a12e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Hsiao Chien Sung <shawn.sung@mediatek.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Dec 2023 13:58:46 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] drm/mediatek: Fix underrun in VDO1 when switches off the
 layer

Do not reset Merge while using CMDQ because reset API doesn't
wait for frame done event as CMDQ does and could lead to
underrun when the layer is switching off.

Fixes: aaf94f7c3ae6 ("drm/mediatek: Add display merge async reset control")

Reviewed-by: CK Hu <ck.hu@mediatek.com>
Reviewed-by: AngeloGioacchino Del Regno <angelogioacchino.delregno@collabora.com>
Signed-off-by: Hsiao Chien Sung <shawn.sung@mediatek.com>
Link: https://patchwork.kernel.org/project/dri-devel/patch/20231214055847.4936-23-shawn.sung@mediatek.com/
Signed-off-by: Chun-Kuang Hu <chunkuang.hu@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/mtk_disp_merge.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/mtk_disp_merge.c
index e525a6b9e5b0..22f768d923d5 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/mtk_disp_merge.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/mtk_disp_merge.c
@@ -103,7 +103,7 @@ void mtk_merge_stop_cmdq(struct device *dev, struct cmdq_pkt *cmdq_pkt)
 	mtk_ddp_write(cmdq_pkt, 0, &priv->cmdq_reg, priv->regs,
 		      DISP_REG_MERGE_CTRL);
 
-	if (priv->async_clk)
+	if (!cmdq_pkt && priv->async_clk)
 		reset_control_reset(priv->reset_ctl);
 }
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/mtk_disp_merge.c`**
   - The condition for resetting the `priv->reset_ctl` has been modified. 
   - The original line:
     ```c
     if (priv->async_clk)
     ```
     has been changed to:
     ```c
     if (!cmdq_pkt && priv->async_clk)
     ```
   - This change ensures that the reset control is only invoked when `cmdq_pkt` is `NULL` and `priv->async_clk` is true, preventing potential underrun issues when switching off the layer.

### Relationships

- The modification in `mtk_disp_merge.c` addresses a specific bug related to the handling of the display merge control when using CMDQ (Command Queue). 
- The change is a direct response to the issue identified in the previous commit (`Fixes: aaf94f7c3ae6`), which introduced the async reset control. 
- By refining the condition under which the reset occurs, the patch aims to ensure that the reset does not interfere with the CMDQ's frame completion events, thereby preventing underrun scenarios when layers are turned off.

Here is the commit message:
drm/mediatek: Fix underrun in VDO1 when switches off the
 layer

Do not reset Merge while using CMDQ because reset API doesn't
wait for frame done event as CMDQ does and could lead to
underrun when the layer is switching off.

Fixes: aaf94f7c3ae6 ("drm/mediatek: Add display merge async reset control")

Reviewed-by: CK Hu <ck.hu@mediatek.com>
Reviewed-by: AngeloGioacchino Del Regno <angelogioacchino.delregno@collabora.com>
Signed-off-by: Hsiao Chien Sung <shawn.sung@mediatek.com>
Link: https://patchwork.kernel.org/project/dri-devel/patch/20231214055847.4936-23-shawn.sung@mediatek.com/
Signed-off-by: Chun-Kuang Hu <chunkuang.hu@kernel.org>

Here is the root cause:
The bug arises from the reset API being called without waiting for the frame done event when using CMDQ. This can lead to an underrun condition when the display layer is switched off, as the reset may occur prematurely, disrupting the ongoing operations managed by CMDQ.

Here is the patch:
 
 void mtk_merge_stop_cmdq(struct device *dev, struct cmdq_pkt *cmdq_pkt)
 {
 	struct mtk_disp_merge *priv = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
 
 	if (priv->mute_support)
 		mtk_ddp_write(cmdq_pkt, 0x1, &priv->cmdq_reg, priv->regs,
 			      DISP_REG_MERGE_MUTE_0);
 
 	mtk_ddp_write(cmdq_pkt, 0, &priv->cmdq_reg, priv->regs,
 		      DISP_REG_MERGE_CTRL);
 
-	if (priv->async_clk)
+	if (!cmdq_pkt && priv->async_clk)
 		reset_control_reset(priv->reset_ctl);
 }

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c

```
```c
if (priv->async_clk)
```
```c
if (cmdq_pkt)
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because the `reset_control_reset` function is called without ensuring that the frame done event has been processed when `CMDQ` is in use. This can lead to an underrun condition when the display layer is switched off, as the reset may happen prematurely, disrupting ongoing operations managed by `CMDQ`. The condition `if (priv->async_clk)` does not account for the state of `cmdq_pkt`, which is crucial for proper synchronization.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (!cmdq_pkt && priv->async_clk)
```
```c
reset_control_reset(priv->reset_ctl);
```
Reason:
The fix modifies the condition to check if `cmdq_pkt` is `NULL` before calling `reset_control_reset`. This ensures that the reset is only performed when `CMDQ` is not in use, thereby preventing premature resets that could lead to underrun conditions when the display layer is being switched off. This change ensures proper synchronization with the ongoing operations managed by `CMDQ`.
